digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite_verify gate; code-review LLM-Review gate
propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite_verify and code-review LLM-Review gate fail with HTTP 400 ValidationException ('Grammar compilation timed out' / 'Schema is too complex') after 180-185 seconds when using native structured output mode with large verification contracts (22-36 optional parameters).

Story 18ae's exact-model-id override row for us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 and us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-* sets native_structured_output=True, causing rebar to send JSON Schemas to Bedrock that exceed Anthropic's documented grammar compilation budget (24 optional parameters, 180-second timeout).

The failure is deterministic and reproducible: identical serial requests consistently fail at ~185 seconds on NativeOutput but succeed in 7-11 seconds on PromptedOutput for the same contracts, ruling out transient/load causes.

output_mode must gate NativeOutput selection on both (a) whether the installed botocore supports the outputConfig parameter and (b) a measured complexity bound (16 optional / 12 union) to prevent schema compilation timeouts.

Schema complexity counting must walk the resolved JSON schema recursively through $defs, items, and nested properties to correctly measure optional parameters across VerificationOutput and similar multi-level contracts; top-level-only counting would silently miss the defect.

The schema-complexity rejection must be classified distinctly in failure.py to avoid surfacing it as a generic provider outage, and structured_run.py must fall back once to PromptedOutput rather than fail closed when the rejection is recognized.
